body:
Source: GitHub issue #809 (bug, P2-medium). Re-verified on main @ 6bf8841c: plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs:602-607 — `if (paths.length === 0) fail(shellTool ? '...' : 'active hook payload did not include any editable paths')`. There is no tool-kind triage before this: any non-shell tool call whose payload yields zero collected paths is denied unconditionally whenever a railed ticket is active — including the plugin's OWN `adlc_gate`/`adlc_prosecute` tools, plus `todo_write`, `fetch`, and any other pathless/planning/MCP tool. Confirmed no `isMutatingToolName`-style function exists (only a `toolName(payload)` accessor at line 434).

Secondary bug, same file: `collectPaths()` (~line 140-161) routes the object keys `['command', 'cmd', 'patch', 'input']` through `collectPatchPaths()`, which only recognizes `*** Add File:`-style apply_patch text. `adlc_prosecute`'s `input` field is a genuine file PATH (e.g. `p5-passes.json`), not patch-format text, so it is silently dropped instead of collected — meaning even fixing the tool-kind triage alone would not by itself let `adlc_prosecute` supply a usable path.

Sibling harnesses already filter by tool identity before reaching this decision: plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/hooks.json uses `"matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"` / `"Bash|Shell"`; plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/hooks.json uses an explicit allowlist regex. Copilot's hook config format (docs/integrations/copilot-probe-appendix.md §2: `{"type":"command","bash":"…","timeoutSec":n}`) has NO matcher key, so `plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/hooks.json` registers rails-guard on preToolUse unfiltered — the triage has to happen inside this hook script itself, which currently does none.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package: plugins/adlc-copilot. The hook script (adlc-rails-guard.mjs) is a standalone file with a documented "KEEP IN SYNC" comment block (lines ~18-32) noting it's a verbatim inline copy of packages/core/lib/shell.mjs's classifier, pinned by plugins/adlc-copilot/test/shell-drift.test.mjs — do NOT touch the shell-classifier functions listed in that comment block; this ticket is about tool-KIND triage (structured tool calls), not the shell-command classifier, and is a different concern. Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/*.test.mjs` from the worktree root. plugins/adlc-copilot/test/rails-guard-contract.test.mjs is the primary existing contract test file for this hook's decision logic; add new tests there.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Add an exact-whole-name allowlist of the plugin's OWN non-file-mutating structured tools (`adlc_gate`, `adlc_prosecute`, and any other MCP tool this plugin ships that takes no editable-file argument — grep plugins/adlc-copilot/mcp/ for the full tool registry to enumerate them) plus common pathless planning/read tools already known to be safe (`todo_write`, `fetch`) — consulted BEFORE the terminal `paths.length === 0` fail(), mirroring the existing "KEEP IN SYNC" precedent of an exact-name (not substring) allowlist used elsewhere in this codebase for the same reason: a substring or heuristic match would risk waving through a genuine future mutator. A tool NOT on this allowlist and NOT shell, with zero collected paths, must still fail closed exactly as today — this ticket narrows the false-positive surface, it does not weaken the fail-closed default for anything unrecognized.
2. Fix `collectPaths()`'s handling of `adlc_prosecute`'s `input` key specifically: either special-case it (treat `input` as a literal path when the tool name is `adlc_prosecute`, not patch text) or split the `['command', 'cmd', 'patch', 'input']` list so `input` goes through direct path collection rather than `collectPatchPaths`. Verify against the tool's actual real argument shape (check plugins/adlc-copilot/mcp/ or packages/prosecute/bin/adlc-prosecute.mjs's CLI contract for what `--input` actually names) before choosing the fix shape.
3. A tool call that IS a genuine structured mutator with an unparseable/opaque target must remain denied — do not broaden the allowlist beyond the specific tools named above without re-verifying each one individually is genuinely non-file-mutating.
4. No documentation changes required (this is an internal hook behavior fix, not a documented contract change) unless docs/integrations/copilot.md or copilot-probe-appendix.md explicitly claims something this fix changes — check and update only if so.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 With an active railed ticket, `adlc_gate` and `adlc_prosecute` payloads (using their REAL argument shapes, not synthetic ones) allow rather than deny. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/rails-guard-contract.test.mjs`
- AC2 `todo_write` and `fetch` (or whichever pathless tools this plugin's own contract already documents as expected-safe) allow under an active railed ticket. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/rails-guard-contract.test.mjs`
- AC3 A genuine opaque structured mutator (unrecognized tool name, zero collected paths, active rails) still denies — negative-space regression pinning the fail-closed default is NOT weakened. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/rails-guard-contract.test.mjs`
- AC4 A rail-target edit (real editable path under a frozen rail) still denies exactly as before — this ticket must not touch the actual rail-matching decision. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/rails-guard-contract.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite green. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-copilot/test/*.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC6 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: the shell-command classifier (shellTokens/shellHasMutation/etc. — already correct and pinned by shell-drift.test.mjs, not part of this bug). Any other harness's rails-guard (this is copilot-only). Changing the Copilot I/O contract (deny/allow response shape) — unrelated to this bug.
title: adlc-copilot: stop denying every pathless non-mutating tool call under active rails
